### Summary

Besides its own YAML format, kintera reads reaction networks in the input format of the KINETICS-base
photochemical model and maps them onto the options of this chapter. This section is a skeleton: only the entry
points are filled in.

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
**Purpose.** Build `KineticsOptions` from a KINETICS-base master input and photolysis catalog.

**Data.** File paths in; a `KineticsOptions` object out.

**Placement.** Setup only, before a `Kinetics` module is built.

**Activation.** API call `KineticsOptions.from_kinetics_base` or `from_kinetics_base_pun`.

**Guarantee / limits.** Not drafted.

**Evidence.** See the Tests layer.
:::

### Derivation

No derivation: this is an input reader. The mapping of each KINETICS-base rate code to a rate form is still to be
written.

### Numerical method

Not drafted.
